Revel Magnetic Wireless Charger with Qi2 Certification

Revel Magnetic Wireless Charger with Qi2 Certification! – experience the charging convenience for iPhone 15/14/13/12! With the Revel Magnetic Wireless Charger, enjoy effortless charge-up for your devices. India’s first “Qi2” certified charger promises top-notch performance and reliability. Supercharge your iPhone with 15W of exclusive wireless charging – twice as fast! Stay worry-free with built-in safety features, meeting international safety standards such as CE, ROHS. The Revel is the only wireless charger in India that can charge both the iPhone and Android (with a magsafe case) at 15W of “Wireless Fast Charging” Includes a 20W Type-C PD wall charger and Type-C to C cable as a complete fast charging kit. Get ready to revel in the future of charging technology!

Revel Magnetic Wireless Qi2 certified Charger delivers 15W of power, charging your iPhone twice as fast wirelessly. India’s first that is Qi2 Certified and supports 15W charging to both iPhones and Androids (with a magsafe case). Works with all iPhones, all wireless enabled Androids and the latest Airpods Pro

The Revel affixes to the back of your iPhone magnetically and fast charges the iPhone at 15W of wireless power. The Revel is the only in India that can provide 15W of “Wireless Fast Charging” to compatible Android phones (with a magsafe case) and iPhones BOTH! The Revel can charge an iPhone 15 Pro 0-90% in under 3 hours – making it the fastest wireless charger in the country!

The most important part of a is the wall charger it connects to. Don’t worry, the Revel comes with its own 1m type C to C Cable and a 20W type C PD Wall charger to deliver fast wireless power to your favourite device.

Qi2 is a Universal Magnetic standard debuted by WPC last year. Qi2 Charging should start featuring in all upcoming flagship Android phones by the end of this year. Magnetic is possible even now with Wireless enabled Android phones – simply by using a Magsafe enabled case for your android phone! The Revel can provide 15W of “Wireless Fast Charging” to compatible flagship Android Devices

The Revel is Qi2 Certified by the Wireless Power Consortium and also holds up against top international safety standards such as CE, ROHS. The Revel comes with a comprehensive warranty and a super easy warranty process. Simply WhatsApp us your issue, and we will solve for you.
